alchemistaccelerator-siro:ashbyhq:a772e7.title: Director of Finance
alchemistaccelerator-siro:ashbyhq:a772e7.description: Field sales powers the economy — but most teams are struggling. Reps are buried in admin work, managers are stretched thin, and leaders can’t see what’s really happening in the field. Siro is redefining how field sales teams learn, perform, and win. We started as an AI-powered coaching platform that helped reps improve their outcomes in the field. Today, we’re something much bigger — an intelligent companion that automates sales reps’ tedious admin work, gives managers real-time visibility, and helps executives see around corners. Our platform integrates with systems like Salesforce, analyzing thousands of in-person sales conversations to surface insights, automate workflows, and drive better outcomes across the org. Think Iron Man’s Jarvis for sales — proactive, personalized, and built directly into the tools teams already use. Siro has raised $75M and is backed by world-class investors like Index, Fika, CRV, and SignalFire. We are trusted by leading home-improvement, retail, hospitality, and automotive brands, and powered by a lean team from Meta, McKinsey, Doordash, and Uber. We’re building the future of human-AI collaboration in sales — and we’re just getting started. ABOUT THE ROLE This is a high-ownership role for someone who wants finance to be a driver of the business, not a scorekeeper. You'll own the numbers end to end — the model, the close, cash, compliance, and the systems under all of it — and you'll use that ownership to sharpen how the whole company makes decisions. It's ideal for a high-slope, deeply detail-oriented operator who is equally uncomfortable with a sloppy reconciliation and with a month spent on work that didn't move the business. You'll go deep — into the model, the ledger, the compliance controls — but you're measured on the decisions and outcomes that depth produces. WHAT YOU'LL DO OWN STRATEGIC FINANCE AND BE A DECISION PARTNER - Own and continuously sharpen the financial model — revenue, ARR, burn, runway, unit economics, and scenario planning - Refine the operating cadence: budgeting, forecasting, board and investor reporting, and monthly business reviews that change what leadership does next - Turn analysis into recommendations — pricing, hiring pace, spend trade-offs, where a dollar returns the most — and push for the call, don't just present options - Be the finance partner in the next fundraise: investor-grade model, data room, and diligence support OWN ACCOUNTING, THE CLOSE, AND CONTROLS - Own a clean, timely monthly close and accurate financials (managing our outsourced accounting/bookkeeping partners) - Build the controls, reconciliations, and reporting that make our numbers audit-ready and investor-ready by default - Own cash: AR/AP, collections, billing accuracy, treasury, and the cash-flow visibility the company runs on - Manage tax, audit, and statutory compliance without letting them become fire drills OWN COMPLIANCE AND SECURITY OPERATIONS - Own the compliance (SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA, GDPR, etc.) program end to end — scope, controls, evidence, auditor relationship, and continuous compliance after certification - Turn security questionnaires and vendor diligence from a deal bottleneck into a fast, repeatable process that helps Sales win - Own the compliance and risk backbone: data handling, vendor risk, insurance, contracts review support, and the policies that scale with us - Partner with Engineering on the controls that reduce risk (not just the ones that check a box) BUILD THE FINANCE FUNCTION AND ITS SYSTEMS - Choose and implement the tooling that lets a small team punch above its weight - Automate and eliminate low-leverage work relentlessly, so the function scales sub-linearly with the company - Set the standards for the finance team we'll build over time WHO YOU ARE - A finance operator with range — you can move from a board-ready strategic model to a bank reconciliation to a SOC 2 control mapping and be rigorous at every altitude - High-slope: you've grown faster than your t

jobgether-jobgether:lever:eee349e7-d035-.title: Senior Mobile Game UI/UX Artist
jobgether-jobgether:lever:eee349e7-d035-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Game UI/UX Artist based in Romania. This is a senior creative role focused on shaping intuitive, expressive, and highly engaging interfaces for mobile games enjoyed by players around the world. You will define the visual identity of the game UI while building scalable systems that keep experiences consistent across devices and screen sizes. The role combines visual design, UX thinking, prototyping, design systems, and close collaboration with game development teams. You will transform concepts into polished interfaces, seamlessly blending 2D UI with 3D game assets while maintaining strong hierarchy and visual impact. You will also contribute to modern AI-assisted workflows that accelerate ideation, exploration, and asset creation. Success requires both artistic excellence and a systems mindset, with a strong understanding of mobile gaming conventions and player behavior. This is an opportunity to make a visible impact in a fast-moving, remote-friendly environment where creativity, experimentation, and collaboration are highly valued. Define and own the visual direction, layout, interaction patterns, and overall artistic quality of mobile game interfaces. Create high-fidelity 2D UI assets, icons, screens, menus, and interactive elements that are colorful, polished, intuitive, and optimized for mobile devices. Integrate 2D UI layers with 3D game assets while maintaining visual hierarchy, depth, readability, and a cohesive aesthetic. Build, scale, and maintain a component-driven UI design system in Figma, including reusable components, variants, variables, auto-layout structures, and responsive behaviors. Design modular and reusable UI components that account for mobile platform constraints and different screen sizes and aspect ratios. Create user flows, wireframes, mockups, interactive prototypes, and iconography that prioritize intuitive navigation, touch ergonomics, and engaging player interactions. Design interfaces for modern free-to-play meta systems, including progression tracks, Battle Passes, collection systems, rewards, and other engagement features. Collaborate closely with programmers, technical artists, producers, and other creative stakeholders to ensure designs are implemented accurately and retain their intended visual quality in-engine. Use generative AI and AI-assisted design tools to accelerate brainstorming, mood-board development, concept exploration, iteration, and asset generation. Maintain clear design documentation and communicate UI logic and design-system principles effectively to technical and creative teams. Contribute to UI animations, visual effects, and other implementation considerations where appropriate. Continuously refine the player experience by balancing visual excitement with clarity, usability, consistency, and performance. Requirements 10+ years of professional game-art experience, including at least 5 years specializing in UI/UX art. A strong portfolio demonstrating exceptional mobile game UI/UX work, including visual case studies or references from at least 2 shipped mobile titles. Excellent understanding of composition, color theory, typography, layout, visual hierarchy, and stylized 2D game-art production. Deep knowledge of mobile game UI principles, including touch interfaces, gesture controls, ergonomics, and iOS/Android design considerations. Strong understanding of free-to-play game meta systems such as Battle Passes, progression tracks, collection systems, and reward loops. Expert-level proficiency with Figma, including auto-layout, nested components, variables, variants, design systems, and interactive prototyping. Strong proficiency with Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator for high-fidelity asset creation, iconography, vectors, textures, and visual treatments. Proven experience creating and managing comprehensive UI design systems and style
